attributes.title: The strongest signal is a team that can use the work.
Programme Director
attributes.description: They made the plan feel less like compliance and more like an operating advantage. The exercise found the issue before the issue found us.

attributes.title: Operations Lead
attributes.description: The work was precise, practical and built around the decisions people would actually need to make under pressure.

attributes.title: Continuity Manager
attributes.description: We left with a system our internal team could run, not a binder that required the vendor to explain it.

sections.note: Built from sbs-testimonial-p43-v2 (SBS Testimonial p43 v2); edited in the SBS DST Page Builder.

attributes.title: Clear answers before the first call.
Can the program start from an incomplete plan?

children.text: Yes. The first step is to identify what is usable, what is missing and which decisions matter first.

attributes.title: Do you support exercises as well as planning?

children.text: Yes. Every major output should have a matching validation or exercise path.

attributes.title: Can this be handed over to an internal team?

children.text: That is the goal. A program that permanently depends on the vendor is not finished.
